entries.content: I can't believe this serum is only $12! Listen, I've tried every expensive serum out there and this drugstore one literally cleared my acne in 2 weeks. Look at my before and after — the texture is completely gone! It has niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, super lightweight, doesn't pill under makeup. Over 50k five-star reviews can't be wrong. Link in bio, grab it before it sells out again!

If you struggle with dark circles like me, you NEED this concealer. It literally makes my under-eyes look airbrushed — no filter! The coverage is insane but somehow it still looks natural. Doesn't crease, doesn't settle into fine lines, and one tiny dot covers everything. I've had the same tube for 4 months and I use it every single day. Best $8 I've ever spent. Link in bio!

This sunscreen changed my life and I'm not exaggerating. Zero white cast, feels like water on the skin, and it actually works under makeup. SPF 50 with skincare benefits — it has centella and green tea to calm redness. I've gone through 5 bottles already. If you hate wearing sunscreen because it feels greasy or breaks you out, TRY THIS ONE. Link in bio, your skin will thank you!
